C1.reason: Antigravity CLI 1.5.10 reached the listener and sent initialize, which Mind Place correctly refused with 401: its MCP configuration does not expand environment variables in headers, so the literal placeholder was sent. Delivering the key would require putting it literally on a command line or in its shared user config (~/.gemini/config), which this harness deliberately does not do. Headless runs also stay in request-review permission mode ('--mode auto' is not available for this account), so tool calls would wait for approval. See receipt blocked-antigravity.json.
